methodology: The original research topic and the generated technical specification were decomposed into atomic units based on individual requirements, features, behaviors, and constraints. Each atomic unit is designed to be independent, self-contained, technically specific, unambiguous, and implementable as a single requirement. This ensures a granular comparison between the two information sources.
mindtraced_atomic_units: The shift register also functions as a down counter
Data is shifted in MSB first when shift_ena is 1
The number in the shift register is decremented when count_ena is 1
Behavior is undefined when both shift_ena and count_ena are 1
Shift operation takes priority when both shift_ena and count_ena are 1
spec_atomic_units: When shift_ena is high, data is shifted into the MSB of q
Other bits of q are shifted down when shift_ena is high
When count_ena is high, q decrements by 1
Behavior is undefined when both shift_ena and count_ena are high
Shift operation takes priority when both shift_ena and count_ena are high
The register's value changes on the positive edge of the clock clk
The register is updated using non-blocking assignments (`<=`)
